_help.buses.music: How loud the music group is, in dB under master (0 = full, -6 = about half). The player's own Music slider in Settings works on top of this.
_help.buses.ambience: How loud the background sounds (wind, crickets, crowd) are, in dB under master.
_help.buses.sfx: How loud the game's sound effects are, in dB under master. Usually 0: effects are the reference the others sit under.
_help.buses.ui: How loud menu and button sounds are, in dB under master. Keep it 6-10 dB under the effects: players hear these hundreds of times.
_help.master.limiterDb: The safety net: nothing gets louder than this (dB). -1 is the standard. Lower = squashes loud moments more.
_help.tiers.small: The sound a "small" juiced moment plays when it has no sound of its own (same intention, same sound).
_help.tiers.medium: The sound a "medium" juiced moment plays when it has no sound of its own.
_help.tiers.big: The sound a "big" juiced moment plays when it has no sound of its own.
_help.ladder.scale: The notes a ladder sound climbs: pentatonic (no wrong notes, the default), major, minorPentatonic or chromatic.
_help.ladder.root: The key your ladder sounds are recorded in, e.g. D. Record or tune them to this note so they sit in the music's key.
_help.ladder.steps: How many notes the ladder climbs before it holds the top note. 5 = one octave on the pentatonic scale.
_help.ladder.resetMs: After this much quiet (ms), the ladder starts again at the bottom note.
_help.snapshots.paused.music: While paused: how much the music drops, in dB (0 = no change).
_help.snapshots.paused.lowpassHz: While paused: the music sounds muffled, as if behind a door. Lower = more muffled. 0 = off.
_help.snapshots.paused.fadeMs: How long (ms) the paused mix takes to fade in and out.
_help.snapshots.reveal.music: During the big reveal: how much the music drops, in dB.
_help.snapshots.reveal.ambience: During the big reveal: how much the background sounds drop, in dB.
_help.snapshots.reveal.fadeMs: How long (ms) the reveal mix takes to fade in and out.
_help.duck.amountDb: When a sound with "duck" plays, the music drops this much (dB) so the moment is clear. -6 to -8 is typical.
_help.duck.downMs: How fast (ms) the music drops for a ducking sound. Short = snappy.
_help.duck.backMs: How long (ms) the music takes to come back up after it ducked.
_help.limits.maxVoices: Most effect + menu sounds playing at once (music and ambience don't count). More than this: the least important, quietest, oldest one is cut. ~14 is a good number.
_help.limits.staleMs: A sound asked for this late (ms) is skipped instead of playing out of sync (catch-up after a hiccup or a reconnect).
_help.sounds.*.files: The files for this sound, inside public/audio/ (e.g. sfx/pop_01.mp3). Two or more = variants, so it doesn't sound like a machine gun.
_help.sounds.*.pick: Which file plays next: random (never the same one twice), sequence (in order) or shuffle (each once, then a new order).
_help.sounds.*.bus: Which volume group it's in: music, ambience, sfx (effects) or ui (menus & buttons).
_help.sounds.*.volumeDb: How loud, in dB. 0 = as recorded, -6 = about half, +6 = about double.
_help.sounds.*.pitch: Higher or lower, in semitones (12 = an octave). Pitch and speed are one knob: higher also plays faster.
_help.sounds.*.randomPitch: Each play is up to this many semitones higher or lower, picked at random. 0.5-1 stops repeats sounding identical.
_help.sounds.*.randomVolumeDb: Each play is up to this many dB louder or quieter, picked at random. 1-3 is subtle.
_help.sounds.*.delayMs: Wait this long (ms) before playing — to line it up with an animation without touching code.
_help.sounds.*.trimStartMs: Skip this much (ms) at the start of the file — cuts silence so it feels instant.
_help.sounds.*.trimEndMs: Cut this much (ms) off the end of the file.
_help.sounds.*.fadeInMs: Fade in over this long (ms). 0 = starts at full volume.
_help.sounds.*.fadeOutMs: Fade out over this long (ms) at the end.
_help.sounds.*.loop: true = plays over and over until stopped (music, ambience).
_help.sounds.*.loopStartMs: Where the loop jumps back to (ms into the file). 0 and 0 = loop the whole file.
_help.sounds.*.loopEndMs: Where the loop ends and jumps back (ms into the file). 0 = the end of the file.
_help.sounds.*.maxVoices: Most copies of this sound at once. One more cuts the oldest copy. 3-4 is typical.
_help.sounds.*.cooldownMs: A repeat sooner than this (ms) is skipped — stops two plays in the same instant doubling up. 30-60 is typical.
_help.sounds.*.priority: How important it is (0-5, higher = more important). When too many sounds play at once, the least important are cut first.
_help.sounds.*.pan: Left or right: -1 = left, 0 = middle, 1 = right.
_help.sounds.*.lowpassHz: Muffle it: only sound below this pitch (Hz) gets through. 0 = off. Try 800-3000.
_help.sounds.*.highpassHz: Thin it: only sound above this pitch (Hz) gets through. 0 = off. Try 200-800.
_help.sounds.*.ladder: true = each quick repeat plays one note higher, up the ladder (see Ladder).
_help.sounds.*.duck: true = the music drops for a moment while it plays (big moments).
